answers.answer: On the initial call (2021-04-13), Anita Kabir raised three concerns: (1) integration is a key concern given the complexity of FutureTech's current systems; (2) support and training are very important to FutureTech; and (3) pricing structures can seem complex at first, noting some other companies have more straightforward pricing upfront.
